Website Terms

Terms governing use of the RT Signature Homes website and its editorial content.

These terms govern use of the RT Signature Homes website. Using the website means you accept these terms.

General information

Website content is provided for general information and initial project exploration. It is not a construction proposal, contract, engineering opinion, architectural document, warranty, or guarantee of price, schedule, permit approval, or outcome.

Design-gallery imagery

Design-gallery and editorial images communicate architectural directions, materials, and planning ideas. They do not document a specific customer, property, completed RT project, permit result, or construction outcome.

Project eligibility

Service availability depends on the property, location, requested scope, timing, capacity, and other project conditions. A website submission does not create a contractor-client relationship or obligate either party to proceed.

Third-party content and links

Google review content is supplied by Google Maps and remains subject to Google’s applicable terms. Other third-party websites are governed by their own terms and policies. RT Signature Homes is not responsible for third-party website content.

Acceptable use

Do not interfere with the website, attempt unauthorized access, submit unlawful or deceptive information, or reuse website content in a way that infringes applicable rights.

Customer-care text messages

When you separately opt in, RT Signature Homes may send customer-care text messages about your inquiry, estimate follow-up, and requested service or project updates. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Consent is not a condition of purchase.

Reply STOP to opt out at any time. Reply HELP for help, email info@rtsignaturehomes.com, or call (206) 407-6291. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. Terms and privacy policies provided by your mobile carrier also apply.

Contact

Questions may be directed to info@rtsignaturehomes.com or (206) 407-6291.
